appearance.book_font_help: Used for passages, previews and comparisons.
appearance.font_sample: “You’re late again,” she said, closing the book. 「또 늦었네.」 그녀가 책을 덮으며 말했다.
model.unreachable_remote: Check the address and key in Settings, then try again.
model.unreachable_local: Make sure it is running on this computer, then try again.
reasoning.label: Reasoning
reasoning.help: How much the model thinks before answering. Translation rarely needs it; higher levels are slower and cost more.
reasoning.best_effort: This service may ignore this setting for some models.
translations.title: Translations
translations.queue.held_restart: The queue is paused because the app restarted
translations.queue.held_desc: Nothing new will start until you resume it. The translation that was running is paused and will continue first.
translations.empty.title: No translations yet
translations.empty.step1: Add a book or subtitle file
translations.empty.step3: Start — it keeps running in the background
job.toast.resume_queued: Queued — it continues after the current translation
job.toast.resume_held: Queued, but the queue is paused. Resume the queue to start.
job.confirm.remove_queue_body: “{{title}}” won’t be translated. You can add it again from New translation.
job.confirm.delete_body: This removes the history of “{{title}}”: its passages, the story notes at each point, and the ability to translate new chapters later.
job.confirm.delete_keeps: Story notes, glossaries and style guides are not deleted.
job.change_model.title: Change model and resume
job.change_model.desc: Passages that are already done stay as they are. The rest use the model you pick.
job.change_model.style_warning: Switching models mid-book can change the tone between the parts translated before and after.
job.add_chapters.title: Translate new chapters
job.add_chapters.desc: Upload the source file with the new chapters added. Parts that match the previous version are reused; only new or changed text is translated.
job.add_chapters.hint: When it finishes, the previous output is kept as “… (before update)”.
job.review.title: Translated passages
job.review.empty: Translated passages appear here as soon as each one is done.
job.review.check_after_polish: You can check it once it's polished
job.done.title: Finished in {{time}}
job.failed.title: The translation stopped because of an error
job.paused.connection_removed_desc: Choose a model with “Change model and resume…” to continue.
job.waiting.title: The service is limiting requests
job.issue.untranslated_desc: The model couldn’t translate these, so they stay in the original language. Retrying often fixes it; a different model or Simplify formatting can help too.
job.issue.failed_desc: These passages hit errors. Retrying only redoes them; finished passages are kept.
job.issue.approximated_one: {{n}} passage may have formatting slightly out of place
job.issue.approximated_other: {{n}} passages may have formatting slightly out of place
job.issue.approximated_desc: The text is translated, but bold, italics or links may sit in slightly different places. If this happens a lot, try Simplify formatting next time.
job.used.title: Settings used
job.notes.latest_help: This is what the model is using right now. Fix characters, genders and terms under “Book-wide”, and things that change over time, like how people address each other, under “As of a passage”.
job.notes.book_help: Characters, aliases, name translations and terms that apply to the whole book.
job.notes.passage_help: The notes as they were at the chosen passage. If you edit them, the notes after it are rebuilt from the source text.
job.notes.empty: No notes yet. They appear after the first passages are translated.
job.rebuild.title: Fix the notes from passage {{n}}?
job.rebuild.running_one: The translation pauses, the notes after this point are rebuilt from the source text ({{n}} update), then it continues.
job.rebuild.running_other: The translation pauses, the notes after this point are rebuilt from the source text ({{n}} updates), then it continues.
job.rebuild.paused: The notes after this point are rebuilt from the source text (about {{n}} requests). Resume the translation afterwards to use them.
job.rebuild.finished_polish: The notes after this point are rebuilt (about {{n}} requests), then the whole book is polished again with the corrected notes (about {{p}} requests).
job.rebuild.finished_translate: The notes after this point are rebuilt (about {{n}} requests). The translation is already finished, so the file won’t change. To apply the corrected notes, choose “Rebuild and polish”.
job.rebuild.kept: Passages that are already translated are kept as they are.
new.title: New translation
new.subtitle: Add files, pick the languages and a model, then start. What you choose here applies to this translation only.
new.connect.title: Connect a model to start
new.connect.body: Start Ollama on this computer, or add an API key for a service like OpenRouter, OpenAI or Gemini.
new.task.title: What do you want to do?
new.task.polish_desc: Your files are already translated. Improve how they read without translating again.
new.task.polish_after_desc: Right after each passage is translated, the model reads it once more and smooths awkward sentences, so you can review the polished text as it comes. About twice the requests.
new.files.title: Files
new.files.desc: EPUB, DOCX, TXT or SRT. Add several to translate them one after another.
new.files.formats: EPUB, DOCX, TXT, SRT · up to 100 MB each
new.files.unsupported: Some files were skipped — only EPUB, DOCX, TXT and SRT are supported
new.files.sequential: Files are translated one after another with the same settings.
new.files.ocr_desc: Fix recognition errors and odd line breaks while translating. Leave off for normal ebooks.
new.lang.title: Languages
new.lang.from_help: Leave empty to detect it from each file.
new.lang.polish_help: The language your files are written in.
new.model.title: Model
new.model.label: Model
new.model.local_help: Runs on this computer: no API cost, but long books can take hours.
new.consistency.title: Consistency
new.consistency.desc: Keep names, genders and terms the same from the first chapter to the last.
new.notes.title: Story notes
new.notes.explain: Notes about characters, genders, nicknames, terms and how people address each other. The model reads them before every passage and keeps them up to date.
new.notes.explain_polish: Notes about characters, genders, nicknames, terms and how people address each other, from an earlier translation of this book.
new.notes.build_desc: Create notes for this book and update them while translating.
new.notes.copy_desc: Use notes from an earlier book or volume. The translation works on its own copy.
new.notes.copy_polish_desc: Read the notes of this book while polishing, so names and speech stay consistent. The notes don’t change.
new.notes.off_desc: Polish the text on its own, without story notes.
new.notes.separate_help: Each file starts with fresh notes.
new.notes.series_help: Files run in the order shown; each volume starts from the previous volume’s notes. If one stops, the next ones wait.
new.style.label: Style guide
new.style.help: Extra instructions such as tone or honorifics. Copied into the translation when it starts.
new.output.title: Output
new.output.keep_desc: Bold, italics, links and layout stay as in the original.
new.output.simplify_desc: Keeps paragraphs and images, drops bold, italics and links. Far fewer passages fail because of formatting.
new.output.bilingual_desc: Put the original under each translated paragraph, like a parallel text.
new.advanced.title: Advanced
new.advanced.passage_help: A passage is the text sent to the model in one request. Smaller passages are more reliable but need more requests; larger ones give the model more context at once.
new.advanced.srt_lines_help: How many subtitle cues are sent together.
new.advanced.chapters_desc: Never let a passage cross a chapter boundary.
new.advanced.pattern_help: Click a placeholder to add it. The result is shown next to each file.
new.advanced.notes_budget_help: Only the most relevant parts are sent, up to this size. 0 sends everything.
new.advanced.notes_lookback_help: How much of the previous text the model sees when updating notes, so facts split across passages aren’t lost.
new.advanced.notes_tidy_help: Merges duplicate character entries now and then (1 extra request each time). 0 = never.
new.advanced.gender: Apply the model’s gender fixes right away
new.advanced.gender_desc: Recommended. When the model decides a gender in the notes is wrong, it is fixed at once. Turn off to change it only when the text clearly says so.
new.summary.title: Summary
new.summary.estimate_needs: Add files, a language and a model to see an estimate.
new.summary.time_unknown: Time unknown — try a few excerpts to measure
new.summary.notes_sequential: Requests run one at a time because the story notes are updated as the translation goes.
new.start_hint: Keeps running if you close this tab · ⌘/Ctrl + Enter
new.remember: Remember these choices for next time
new.reason.upload_failed: Remove the files that failed to upload.
new.reason.no_target: Choose the language to translate into.
new.reason.no_language: Choose the language of your files.
new.reason.no_notes_source: Choose the notes to start from.
new.toast.queued_behind: Queued — it starts after the current translation
compare.title: Compare models
compare.subtitle: Try several models on a few excerpts from your book and compare quality, speed and price.
compare.drop: Drop a book to sample from
compare.notes_help: Gives every model the same notes. Notes aren’t updated here.
compare.passages_desc: Taken from across the book, skipping the very beginning and end.
compare.no_more: There are no more excerpts to pick
compare.honest: Excerpts are short plain-text samples: formatting and building story notes aren’t tested here.
compare.stop_note: Requests already sent will still finish.
compare.polish_failed_draft: Polishing failed · showing the first translation
compare.fallback_help: The model didn’t follow the answer format, so its raw reply is shown.
compare.warning.warning_small_document: The document is short: {{count}} excerpts instead of {{requested}}.
connection.test_chat_failed: The service lists models, but the chosen model didn’t answer: {{error}}
connection.confirm.delete_body: Its saved keys are removed. Translations that used it will ask you to pick another model before resuming.
connection.field.name: Name
connection.field.address_help_ollama: Usually http://localhost:11434. Another computer works too, e.g. http://192.168.0.10:11434.
connection.field.address_help_openai: Just the base address works — e.g. http://localhost:8080 or http://localhost:1234/v1. You don’t need to type /chat/completions.
connection.field.address_proxy_help: Only change this if you use a proxy or a self-hosted gateway.
connection.field.keys_help: One per line. With several keys, the next one is used automatically when one hits its rate limit.
connection.field.local_desc: Local models are free but slower; requests run one at a time and get more time to answer.
connection.field.default_model_help: Pre-selected when you start a new translation.
connection.field.test_first: Test the connection to list models, or type a name
connection.field.timeout_help: How long to wait for one answer before retrying.
connection.field.rate_retry_help: The translation waits as long as the service asks (or the time below) and continues on its own.
connection.field.rate_pause_help: The translation pauses; resume it yourself from the translation list.
connection.field.rate_wait: seconds if the service doesn’t say
connection.field.temperature_help: Lower is more literal and consistent, higher is more varied. Most people should keep the provider default.
connection.type_desc.ollama: Models running in Ollama on this or another computer.
connection.type_desc.ollama_cloud: Large models hosted by Ollama. Needs an Ollama API key.
connection.type_desc.openai: GPT models with an OpenAI API key.
connection.type_desc.openai_compatible: llama.cpp, LM Studio, vLLM, LocalAI or any server that speaks the OpenAI API.
connection.type_desc.openrouter: Hundreds of models from many providers with one key.
connection.type_desc.gemini: Gemini models with a Google AI Studio key.
connection.type_desc.mistral: Mistral models with a Mistral API key.
connection.type_desc.deepseek: DeepSeek models with a DeepSeek API key.
connection.type_desc.poe: Bots on Poe with a Poe API key.
settings.title: Settings
settings.connections.desc: Services and servers that run the models. Keys are stored on this computer and never shown again in full.
notes.title: Story notes
notes.subtitle: What the model knows about each book’s characters and world.
notes.explain: Every translation works on its own copy of its notes, so editing a note here only affects translations you start later. To fix notes for a translation in progress, open it and use its Story notes tab.
notes.empty_desc: Notes are created automatically when you translate a book with “Build as I go”.
notes.col.name: Name
notes.field.name: Name
notes.confirm.delete_body: The notes file is deleted. Finished translations aren’t affected.
notes.locked.title: A translation in progress uses these notes
notes.locked.desc: They can’t be edited here until it finishes. To fix them for that translation, open it:
notes.scope.story_help: How people address each other and how relationships change. The model updates these as it reads.
notes.edit_help: One entry per line, written as “- Name: details”. Saving tidies the notes the same way translation does; you’ll see the result before it’s stored.
notes.help.characters: Who’s who, with gender and anything that affects pronouns or speech.
notes.help.aliases: Other names, nicknames and titles for the same person.
notes.help.name_map: Built automatically from characters, aliases and terms; edit those instead.
notes.help.glossary: Places, objects and invented words with their translations.
notes.help.addressing: How each character currently addresses the others (honorifics, formal or casual speech).
notes.help.relationships: How relationships have changed so far.
notes.preview.normalized: After tidying, these sections will read:
notes.preview.clean: Nothing will be changed or dropped.
styles.title: Style guides
styles.subtitle: Extra instructions for the model: tone, honorifics, names, formatting.
styles.new_desc: Write it as you would brief a human translator.
styles.empty_desc: A style guide adds your own instructions to every passage, for example “Keep Japanese honorifics” or “Use 반말 between friends”.
styles.col.name: Name
styles.field.name: Name
styles.field.translation_placeholder: Keep Japanese honorifics like -san and -sama. Translate sound effects. Use casual speech between close friends.
styles.field.polish_help: Used only by the polish pass. Leave empty to use none.
styles.snapshot_note: Translations copy the guide when they start, so changes here apply to translations you start later.
styles.error.exists: A style with this name already exists.
styles.error.name: Use only letters, numbers, spaces, - and _ in the name.
styles.confirm.delete_body: Translations that already started are not affected.
connection.type_desc.neuralwatt: Open models served by Neuralwatt with a Neuralwatt API key.
translations.queue.held_user_desc: Nothing new will start until you resume it.
translations.queue.held_new: New translations will wait in the queue until you resume it.
